test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some vehicles are helicopters.

All helicopters are cars.

**Conclusions:**

I. All vehicles are cars.

II. Some vehicles are cars.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
Statements:

Some vehicles are helicopters.

All helicopters are cars.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a82486b194fa86c16c5f850044271e7d9c697cd7d23bd4814052d8bbb4b8c352.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All vehicles are cars - False (Because, Some Vehicles are Cars but All vehicles are cars can be possible only).

II. Some vehicles are cars - **True** (Because, those part of Vehicles that is Helicopters is definitely Cars).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
